name: No U-Turn
spec: white square with a black U-turn arrow inside a red circle with a red diagonal slash

snippets.back: Rectangular regulatory signs control traffic and direct your speed and direction, such as go straight or turn left, no U-turn, no left turn and no right turn.
Make U-turns with a signal from the left lane across double yellows, in residential two-hundred-foot gaps, at green lights lacking NO U-TURN signs, or through divided openings.
A U-turn reverses your direction on the same road; it is banned where No U-turn signs are posted and anywhere it would endanger others, so go on to the next street or turnaround instead.
A posted No U-turn sign prohibits making a U-turn.
A U-turn reverses travel direction and is allowed only with a safe clear path and no No U-Turn sign.
A U-turn reverses your direction with a half-circle turn, is allowed only when it will not disrupt other traffic, and is forbidden wherever a No U-Turn sign is posted.

Make a U-turn only when safe, never on a curve or near a hill crest where others may not see you, never at a No U-Turn sign, and never at an intersection controlled by a signal or police officer; some towns ban them.
A No U Turn sign prohibits reversing direction at that intersection.
